steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. How does a transformer neural network work, conceptually?

steps.action:
At a high level, a Transformer turns an input sequence into contextualized representations by repeatedly doing two things in parallel:

1. Self-Attention: each token project its embedding into Query, Key and Value vectors; you compute attention scores by taking dot-products of Queries with all Keys, softmax to get weights, and use those to sum the Values—so every position “looks at” every other position in a single shot.  
2. Feed-Forward + Residual/Norm: you pass each position’s attended vector through a small feed-forward network, then add it back to the input (residual connection) and apply layer normalization.

By stacking many such layers (and in the decoder adding cross-attention to encoder outputs), the model learns rich, long-range dependencies without any recurrence.
